texto: To describe a catarral picture, expressions such as «ik ben verkouden» (I'm cold) and «ik hoest» (I cough / have cough) are used. «Koorts» is a fever («Heeft u koorts?»). To see if the state gets worse, the «erger» (worse) comparative adjective is used: «Wordt de hoest erger?» (does the cough get worse?).
